summary: Adds reviewed managed Gmail inbox-v1 operation kinds mark-read and mark-unread, capabilities.readState, and additive migration 0535 widening managed_gmail_operation_receipts_kind_check.

contract.proposal: {kind:'mark-read'|'mark-unread', messageId, expectedHistoryId}; fields allowlist, providerId(messageId), text(expectedHistoryId,100,true); requireScope(modify) else 403; GET /messages/{id}?format=minimal; id/historyId mismatch -> 409 'Selected message changed; review its current labels'
contract.review: {kind, messageId, expectedHistoryId, from: grant.email}; digest = inboxDigest(JSON.stringify(review))
contract.perform: POST /messages/{id}/modify with {removeLabelIds:['UNREAD']} (mark-read) or {addLabelIds:['UNREAD']} (mark-unread); readback labelIds must exclude/include UNREAD else throws (receipt outcome-unknown, never replayed)
contract.result: {messageId, labelIds, historyId: result.historyId ?? null, unread: boolean}
contract.capabilities: readState: supported('modify'); older servers omit it and clients treat absence as false

migration.constraint: managed_gmail_operation_receipts_kind_check (verified by pg_constraint lookup in PGlite test)
migration.snapshot: none; neighbouring migrations 0473-0534 have no drizzle snapshot and the table is raw-SQL only
